dashboard_description: Draft in Markdown, preserve every revision in Git, and keep signature work ready for people and agents.
recent_description: One send is one envelope and one Git history, even when it contains several files.
activity_description: Human and automation actions share one attributable event stream.
agent_ready_description: Stable commands, idempotency keys, scoped credentials and webhooks are first-class—not UI afterthoughts.
source_history_description: DOCX and PDF are generated artifacts. Only Markdown source and its manifest belong to the envelope Git repository.
signing_access_description: Your private signing link is active. Access is checked again whenever this page is opened.
signing_controls_next: Signing and approval controls are the next implementation step.
signing_documents_description: Review every document included in this signing request.
signing_document_rendering_policy: External images are omitted. HTTPS links open in a new tab; email links use your mail app.
signing_document_unicode_warning: Invisible Unicode controls are shown as U+ markers.
signing_document_source_description: Exact Markdown source for verification. No formatting or external resources are applied.
signing_invalid_title: This signing link is not active
signing_invalid_description: The link may be invalid, expired, revoked, waiting for an earlier recipient, or associated with an action that is already complete. Contact the sender if you need clarification.
signing_unavailable_description: Please wait a moment and open the link again. No signing action was recorded.

signing_approve_description: Confirm your review and approve this agreement to proceed.
signing_approve_dialog_description: Approving confirms your review of the agreement documents and records your approval.
signing_approve_retry_pending: Could not approve the agreement. You can try again.
signing_approve_failed: Could not approve the agreement. This signing link is no longer active.
signing_approved_receipt_description: You have approved this agreement. Your approval has been recorded.
signing_approve_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to confirm and record an approval.
signing_fields_description: Fill in every field below, then sign to complete this agreement.
signing_sign_description: Review your entries, then sign to complete this agreement.

signing_sign_validation_failed: Review your entries and try again. Your signing link is still active.

signing_signed_receipt_description: You have signed this agreement. Your entries have been recorded.
signing_sign_no_js_explanation: JavaScript is required to submit and record your signature.
